title: Spectral graph convolutional neural network for Alzheimer's disease diagnosis and multi-disease categorization from functional brain changes in magnetic resonance images.
summary: A spectral graph-convolutional network classified Alzheimer’s disease and multiple disease categories from functional MRI, reporting diagnostic performance and disease-related imaging features.
ai_technology: Machine-learning analysis applies the stated model to the paper’s medicine dataset and evaluates the reported outcome.
